title: Mastering the Physical Examination of the Athlete's Hip.
journal: American journal of orthopedics (Belle Mead, N.J.)

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: In this review, we describe precise methods for evaluating the athlete's hip or groin with an emphasis on recognizing the most common extra-articular and intra-articular pathologies, including adductor strains, athletic pubalgia, osteitis pubis, and femoroacetabular impingement with labral tears.
